description_en: Queries the statistics information on the number of cores for assets protected by Security Center
description_zh: 查询已接入云安全中心防护的资产的核数统计信息
name: DescribeAssetSummary

TotalAssetAllRegion.description_en:
The total number of assets in all regions.
Security Center uses independent service centers in the Chinese mainland and outside the Chinese mainland. You can determine the current service region based on the endpoint you connect to. For more information about the regions included in each service region, see [What is Security Center]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42302.html）
TotalAssetAllRegion.description_zh:
所有区域资产总数。
云安全中心在中国内地与非中国内地采用独立的服务中心。您可以根据接入的endpoint确认当前访问的服务区域。关于不同区域包含的地域详情，请参见[什么是云安全中心]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42302.html）
